prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing in connects your desktop pet to your cloud account so your pet state and accessories are always preserved."]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name to make it officially yours.", "Companion Name", "Enter name"]
2: ["Run Desktop Display Check"]
3: ["Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet on your screen."]
4: ["Select How to Create Your Desktop Pet", "Choose a pre-designed companion for instant launch or upload photos for a custom creation."]
5: ["Clear Lighting & Frontal View Recommended", "Photo Quality Check: Ready"]
6: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Connect your account to save your companion. If browser window does not open, check your system tray or firewall settings."]
7: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Companion", "Preparing animations, desktop overlay permissions, and companion assets."]
8: ["Unlocked: Special Edition Desktop Pet Collar"]
9: ["Want to start immediately? Choose Pick a Friend on the next screen for instant desktop pet launch!"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or special edition items
